items.title: Coldcard strengthens seed generation with firmware update
items.summary: Coinkite urged Coldcard users to generate new seed phrases, warning that existing vulnerable seeds remain unsafe despite the security upgrade.

items.title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
items.summary: Rapid7 unveiled a new cryptocurrency phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers, aiming to steal investors’ holdings by redirecting them to fake wallet provider websites.

items.title: Analysts split on whether Bitcoin's surge past key levels signals a new bull run
items.summary: Market watchers say sudden sharp price spikes and forced short liquidations are the classic signs of a bottom, though macro risks still remain.

items.title: Zcash jumps 48% to over $800 as Grayscale spot ETF push adds to ‘next bitcoin’ buzz
items.summary: ZEC traded above its January 2018 peak as futures volume hit billions of dollars and a Grayscale filing showed fresh progress toward converting its Zcash Trust into a spot ETF.

items.title: How a Treasury buyback tweak helped bitcoin surge 25% to nearly $80,000 in days
items.summary: Treasury buybacks are not QE, analysts said, but the move helped pull long-term yields off 19-year highs and triggered a record short squeeze in a market already leaning too bearish.

items.title: Crypto advocates join in suing Illinois over digital asset tax
items.summary: The Crypto Council for Innovation and the Blockchain Association added another lawsuit against the state for its recently approved 0.2% crypto tax.

items.title: Pass the Clarity Act
items.summary: Reopening a settled provision four weeks before a vote would sink the bill, argues Summer Mersinger, CEO of the Blockchain Association.

items.title: Ethena's ENA token surges 48%, but altcoin season will have to wait
items.summary: ENA is rallying on a $1 billion FalconX deal, while HYPE tests its record, though flat dominance shows this is no broad alt season.

items.title: Coldcard ships firmware after $114 million bitcoin theft; says AI helped catch more bugs
items.summary: Three weeks of review turned up problems unrelated to the flaw that cost users $114 million, but updating still does not make a compromised wallet safe.

items.title: The hard truth is that the Clarity Act is an anti-crypto bill
items.summary: After years of stalled bills, misguided enforcement, and catastrophic collapses, almost any comprehensive crypto legislation began to look like progress. But Clarity is turning that hunger for progress into a political trap, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

items.title: Bitcoin faces $80,000 test as thinner weekend liquidity looms
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Aug. 21, 2026

items.title: Nomura-backed Laser Digital wins Japan's first crypto approval in four years
items.summary: Laser Digital Japan will offer liquidity to domestic crypto providers, with institutional trading services planned to follow as the appetite for crypto in Japan grows.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $77,000 as best week since 2023 pulls altcoins along for the ride
items.summary: BTC has gained 24% since Monday and reached the level implied by its inverse head-and-shoulders break, with shorts still taking a contrarian position.

items.title: Treasury's latest measure isn't QE or YCC. Still, bitcoin is skyrocketing. Here's why.
items.summary: The rally in hard assets isn’t necessarily about what the Treasury is doing, but what its move signals to the market.

items.title: Strategy sits on $1.4 billion profit on bitcoin holdings as price surges
items.summary: Strategy’s common stock rose 10% in Friday pre-market trading to $120, the highest level in two months.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips back to $77,000 after challenging $80,000 overnight
items.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs pulled in $606 million on Aug. 20 and ether funds $221 million, both bigger than the prior day, confirming the institutional bid behind bitcoin's run.

items.title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
items.summary: The token touched $0.004126 minutes before the network stopped producing blocks, while MANTRA later said an attacker exploited a vulnerability in software used by the chain.

items.title: Ripple backs an RLUSD credit fund amid XRP's best week in months
items.summary: Clearpool and Cicada Partners are building an institutional lending product using RLUSD, though the XRP Ledger features underpinning it are still awaiting activation.

items.title: Bitcoin, ether and solana climb as another $1 billion shorts get wiped out
items.summary: The two-day short liquidation total has surpassed $4 billion, with Thursday's figure setting a record dating back to 2021.

items.summary: "Bears in pain, right now," wrote bitcoin analyst James Check.
